content: The eagle does not stoop to hunt common flies.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Aquila non capit muscas — Classical European & Celtic Gnoma
explanation: The monarch of the sky has wings that span eight feet and talons built to grasp salmon from mountain rivers. It does not waste its precious altitude or kinetic energy darting after annoying gnats. Elevate your mind above petty gossip and minor insults.
practicalInsight: Refuse to be drawn into petty arguments or minor social media squabbles today. Fly like an eagle above the flies.
reflectionPrompt: What petty, insignificant drama have you been wasting your precious mental altitude trying to catch?
